data.title: tilt down across worktrees + clone GC|tilt down (internal/cli/down.go) deletes manifests for ALL Tiltfile CRs incl worktrees; removes tilt.dev/worktree-annotated clones. Reconciler GC pass prunes clones whose tiltfile:<wt> CR is gone (annotation-keyed owner lookup) — handles worktree dir deleted while running. Tests: down removes clones; GC prunes orphans.
